flow-definition.description:
Mints new values for the secrets the PIC-SURE services share on one stack, then redeploys every service that carries one. Rotating and redeploying are a single operation; there is no option to render without deploying.
Pick what to rotate. At least one is required: ROTATE_STACK_SECRETS - PICSURE_APPLICATION_TOKEN, QUERY_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN and AGGREGATE_OBFUSCATION_SALT, shared by gateway, operations and query. ROTATE_LOGGING_API_KEY - LOGGING_API_KEY, shared by gateway, operations, visualization, dictionary, PSAMA, the frontend and pic-sure-logging on every stack. ROTATE_PICSURE_INTERNAL_TOKEN: PICSURE_INTERNAL_TOKEN, checked by the dictionary and presented by auth HPDS on every stack.
The gateway carries secrets from the first two sets, so either of them renders and redeploys it. The other services are pulled in only by the flag that needs them, and a flag left false makes the render read those values back out of the rendered env files and preserve them unchanged. Rotating the first two in one run is the usual case after an exposure, because a leaked gateway.env carries all four, and it restarts the gateway once instead of twice.
ROTATE_STACK_SECRETS touches only the selected stack. Those values live in per-stack objects and no request crosses between stacks, so the other stack keeps its own values and is never rendered, redeployed or read. LOGGING_API_KEY is different: one key serves every stack, held in the stackless configs/pic-sure-logging/logging.env. This job renders and redeploys the selected stack's consumers, but every other stack's gateway, operations and visualization keep the old key until they are rendered and redeployed too, and their audit events are dropped until then.
Why the redeploy is not optional: containers bake their env at create time. A rotated QUERY_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN that no container has picked up leaves InternalTokenFilter rejecting the stale value with 403, which the gateway flattens into an opaque 500 on query downloads while every other endpoint keeps working. A rotated LOGGING_API_KEY leaves pic-sure-logging answering 401 while the logging client drops the audit event.
With ROTATE_LOGGING_API_KEY, expect a short window between the Wildfly deploy and the logging deploy where the services already present the new key and pic-sure-logging still checks the old one. One key covers every service, so the two sides cannot cut over at the same instant; the window is a cost of the single-key design rather than a defect.
ROTATE_LOGGING_API_KEY also refreshes PSAMA: it runs Upload PSAMA Configuration with REFRESH_LOGGING_KEY, which writes the new key into the shared psama.env, then redeploys PSAMA with the other services. It leaves a manual tail, and the job says so when it finishes. Render and redeploy the gateway, operations and visualization on every other stack. The frontend reads LOGGING_API_KEY from configs/pic-sure-frontend/<target_stack>/bdc.env, which is uploaded by hand and not rendered here. Download the rendered configs/pic-sure-logging/logging.env to read the new key, then for each stack download its bdc.env through Download PIC-SURE-Frontend Configuration, set LOGGING_API_KEY to match, upload it and redeploy the frontend. Until then those services' audit events are dropped. The key is never printed to this job's console.
ROTATE_STACK_SECRETS changes AGGREGATE_OBFUSCATION_SALT, so this stack's reported aggregate counts shift for queries run before and after. The two stacks already carry different salts and report slightly different counts for the same query; that is a property of per-stack salts rather than a fault.
PICSURE_INTERNAL_TOKEN is one value for every stack, like LOGGING_API_KEY: the dictionary reads it from the stackless configs/picsure-dictionary/picsure-dictionary.env, and each stack's auth HPDS presents it from its own auth-hpds.env. ROTATE_PICSURE_INTERNAL_TOKEN renders both files for the selected stack with a new value, then redeploys that stack's dictionary and auth HPDS. The auth HPDS deploy runs last. DATA_S3_OBJECT_KEY and GENOMIC_DATASET_S3_OBJECT_KEY are required with this flag and the run refuses to start without them: the auth HPDS host treats an empty key as the dataset it was provisioned with, and would roll a stack whose data was deployed since then back to it. Every other stack is left as a manual tail, and the job says so when it finishes: run Render PIC-SURE Configuration there with RENDER_AUTH_HPDS and ADOPT_PICSURE_INTERNAL_TOKEN true, at the infrastructure revision that stack runs, then PIC-SURE Dictionary Deploy and PIC-SURE HPDS Auth Deploy together. Until then that stack keeps working on the old value, because both of its containers still hold it. Redeploying only one of the two there ends its PFB exports in ERROR. Every render there that includes the dictionary or auth HPDS aborts on the mismatch until the adopt run is done, and that covers the Deployment Pipeline, the dictionary and auth HPDS Build and Deploy jobs, and a LOGGING_API_KEY or PICSURE_INTERNAL_TOKEN rotation on that stack. Expect a window on the selected stack where PFB exports fail, from the dictionary deploy until the auth HPDS deploy has finished. When LOGGING_API_KEY rotates in the same run the logging deploy sits between the two, so the window covers it as well.
If a run stops after the render, whichever flags were set, the new values are already in S3 and a rerun would mint new ones on top of them. The job then ends by naming exactly the uploads and deploys that are still owed, to be run by hand in the order given.
TOKEN_INTROSPECTION_TOKEN is not rotated here. PSAMA holds it in the application table and validates every stack's gateway against that single row, so unlike everything above it is genuinely fleet-wide. It is minted by Update PIC-SURE Token Introspection Token.

hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: TARGET_STACK
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: The stack to rotate. Based on selection we determine if is a or b stack. No other stack is touched.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: ROTATE_STACK_SECRETS
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Mint new PICSURE_APPLICATION_TOKEN, QUERY_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN and AGGREGATE_OBFUSCATION_SALT values. Pulls in operations and query alongside the gateway, and redeploys all three.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: ROTATE_LOGGING_API_KEY
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Mint a new LOGGING_API_KEY. Pulls in operations, visualization, dictionary, PSAMA and pic-sure-logging alongside the gateway on this stack, and redeploys them. The key is shared by every stack, so it leaves manual steps for the other stacks and every frontend bdc.env; see the job description.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: ROTATE_PICSURE_INTERNAL_TOKEN
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Mint a new PICSURE_INTERNAL_TOKEN. Renders the shared dictionary env and this stack's auth HPDS env, and redeploys this stack's dictionary and auth HPDS. Requires DATA_S3_OBJECT_KEY and GENOMIC_DATASET_S3_OBJECT_KEY. The value is shared by every stack, so it leaves manual steps for the other stacks; see the job description.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: DATA_S3_OBJECT_KEY
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Required with ROTATE_PICSURE_INTERNAL_TOKEN and ignored otherwise. The dataset key the stack's auth HPDS serves now, passed to PIC-SURE HPDS Auth Deploy. An empty key would make the host fall back to the dataset it was provisioned with. Take it from the last successful PIC-SURE HPDS Auth Deploy build for this stack, or from the Deployment Pipeline run that built the stack when there has been none since.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: GENOMIC_DATASET_S3_OBJECT_KEY
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Required with ROTATE_PICSURE_INTERNAL_TOKEN and ignored otherwise. The genomic dataset key the stack's auth HPDS serves now, found in the same places as DATA_S3_OBJECT_KEY.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: INFRASTRUCTURE_GIT_HASH
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Infrastructure repository revision to render the rotated configuration from. Leave empty to resolve it from build-spec.json.
